correctness.rationale: I independently enumerated all \(7^7=823543\) vertex maps for the fourteen displayed facets and recovered exactly 27979 simplicial self-maps with image sizes 7,2646,25284,0,0,0,42. The 42 surjections are exactly the affine permutations \(i\mapsto ai+b\) of \(\mathbb Z/7\); every other simplicial image is a simplex and hence is directly contiguous to a constant. A direct check of every one-coordinate move from every affine automorphism found none contiguous, and the facet-star intersection argument proves isolation symbolically. An independent integral cocycle pullback calculation reproduced exactly six H1 matrices, each with multiplicity seven. Since the torus is \(K(\mathbb Z^2,1)\) and \(\mathbb Z^2\) is abelian, those six distinct induced maps give six non-null unbased homotopy classes, while the non-automorphisms are null by contiguity.
risks: Only homotopy classes represented by direct simplicial self-maps of this fixed triangulation are classified; arbitrary continuous torus maps realize infinitely many matrices.

originality.rationale: The classical small-triangulation literature supplies the seven-vertex torus and its symmetry setting, and general contiguity literature supplies the fact that contiguous realizations are homotopic. Neither inspected source gives the complete simplicial endomorphism count, the 43 contiguity classes, the affine-plus-zero class monoid, or the six H1 actions. Resultary searches returned the current record and related finite-model mapping classifications but no earlier theorem implying the 27979/27937/42 decomposition. The finite census and contiguity-versus-homotopy comparison are therefore original to the best of current evidence.

value.rationale: The result quantifies a concrete and striking gap between simplicial contiguity on a vertex-minimal torus and ordinary torus homotopy: 43 direct contiguity classes collapse to seven ordinary classes. The complete map census, monoid description, and explicit H1 action spectrum form a natural structural classification of a canonical minimal triangulation.
risks: This is not a classification of all continuous self-maps or maps after subdivision.
